$comment: The sub packs of this language: one school day of REVIEW for one grade. Which blocks, how long, which teaching point and worksheet type. Everything else is filled by scripts/sub-plans/assemble.js. status 'pilot' = noindex, in no sitemap, linked from nowhere. Times are seat-work times a first grader can hold (10 to 25 minutes); the day's read-aloud, movement and quiet reading come from the class information sheets, not from worksheets. The reading block needs a page with text to READ (a picture-only page is not a reading block).

packs.title: First Grade Sub Plans: A Day of Review
packs.metaTitle: First Grade Sub Plans: A Day of Review, Ready to Print
packs.metaDescription: Emergency sub plans for first grade: eight review blocks in reading, word work, writing, and math, with a guest teacher script, early-finisher pages, and class forms.
